data.explanation: COVID-19 pandemic impact: Unemployment skyrocketed to 14.7% as businesses closed. Consumer confidence plummeted to historic lows. Federal Reserve slashed rates to near-zero.
Continued pandemic crisis: Unemployment remained near historic highs. Consumer confidence stayed depressed as lockdowns persisted across most states.
Strong recovery underway: Unemployment dropped sharply as businesses reopened. Consumer confidence surged past pre-pandemic levels on stimulus spending and vaccine rollout.
Labor market tight: Unemployment fell to multi-decade lows. Consumer confidence remained elevated despite rising inflation concerns.
Inflation concerns: Fed began aggressive rate hikes to combat surging prices. Consumer confidence cooled as borrowing costs increased.
Aggressive tightening: Federal Reserve raised rates at historical pace to fight inflation. Consumer spending showed signs of slowing.
Rates at 15-year highs: Fed policy rate reached levels not seen since 2007. Consumer confidence remained resilient but showed strain.
Resilient economy: Despite high rates, labor market remained strong and consumer confidence rebounded on solid job growth.
Consumer resilience: Spending remained robust despite elevated rates. Low unemployment supported continued economic expansion.
Rate hike cycle paused: Federal Reserve held rates steady for first time in tightening cycle. Consumer confidence moderated.
Soft landing emerging: Economy showed signs of stabilizing without recession. Consumer sentiment improved on cooling inflation.
Steady expansion: Economic growth continued at moderate pace. Labor market remained tight with low unemployment supporting consumer spending.
Gradual slowdown: Signs of economic cooling appeared with unemployment edging higher. Consumer confidence softened but remained elevated.
First rate cut in 4 years: Federal Reserve began lowering rates as inflation cooled. Consumer confidence stabilized on policy shift.
Recovery gaining momentum: Rate cuts and cooling inflation boosted consumer sentiment. Holiday shopping season exceeded expectations.
Growth accelerating: Economic activity picked up as monetary policy eased. Consumer confidence reached multi-year highs.
Growth moderating: Economic expansion continued at more sustainable pace. Consumer confidence remained elevated.
Stable growth: Economy settled into steady expansion mode. Labor market remained healthy with moderate job gains.
Strong holiday season: Consumer spending surged on lower rates and rising confidence. Economic outlook brightened for 2026.
Momentum building: Economic growth accelerated into new year. Consumer confidence reached decade highs on improving labor market.
Robust expansion: Job growth remained strong and wages rose. Consumer spending powered economic expansion despite global uncertainties.
Growth stabilizing: Economic activity settled into sustainable pace. Consumer confidence moderated but remained healthy.
